engine: gapsystudio's overlay menu — a FULL-SCREEN overlay (not a sliding panel) on the studio near-white field. LEFT: a big condensed nav list whose items are GHOST-GREY by default and go SOLID on hover, with the current page kept RED. RIGHT: a contact column (socials, email/phone, 'download presentation'). On open the nav items STAGGER in (fade + rise); a 'Close' pill + Escape close it; the logo persists. Harvested from D_gapsy (B overlay menu: HOME(red) / SERVICES / CASES / INDUSTRIES / WHO WE ARE / BLOG / CONTACTS / BOOK A CALL).

measured_teardown.move: open(): the overlay fades opacity 0->1; each nav item fades opacity 0->1 + translateY 24px->0 with a top-to-bottom STAGGER (per-item transition-delay = index * stagger), ease-out; the contact aside fades + lifts after a small delay. Hover an item -> it goes solid (color ghost->ink); the current-page item is .is-current (red, #f0473e). close(): reverse; Escape or the Close pill close it; <html> overflow locked while open; focus moves into the menu on open and returns on close.
measured_teardown.cited: gapsy overlay menu: a full-screen near-white overlay; left = big condensed nav, ghost-grey default, the current page (HOME) red, hovered item solid; right = OUR SOCIAL + GET IN TOUCH + DOWNLOAD COMPANY PRESENTATION; a dark 'Close' pill top-right; the logo persists.

trigger.what: selector(s) of the button(s) that open the menu.

closeSelector.what: selector(s) of the close control(s); also Escape closes.

stagger.what: delay between consecutive nav items in the open ladder (per-item transition-delay).

entry: MenuTrackedStagger.create(target, opts) -> { open(), close(), toggle(), set(p), isOpen(), destroy }. target = .mts-overlay > .mts-nav(.mts-item x N, one optional .is-current) + .mts-aside + the page has the trigger(s) + .mts-close. The reveal is CSS-driven via the .is-open class (per-item --mts-delay set by JS); set(p 0..1) is a PURE scrub for previews.
law: transform: translateY (items, aside) + opacity only; JS toggles .is-open / .is-shown + sets per-item --mts-delay; NO mix-blend / NO backdrop; NO WebGL; Escape closes, <html> overflow locked while open, focus into-menu-on-open + return-on-close; reduced-motion -> instant. owns_pin false, owns_scroll false (a triggered overlay). Z-INDEX LESSON (F-10): the Close control must out-rank the page header trigger (--mts-close-z 200 > the bar) or the header eats the close click.
gate_mode: triggered overlay (open/close), NOT scroll. Verify: closed overlay opacity 0; open -> overlay 1 + items staggered (item i delay = i*stagger); current item RED, ghost items faded, hover -> solid; Close pill + Escape both close; the Close click actually lands (z-index above the header). Smoothness via open/close cycles. Distinct from Saisei dual-panel-menu (two sliding coloured panels): this is ONE full-screen overlay + ghost->solid hover nav + a contact column.
proven: lab: a full-screen overlay over the studio field. Measured live: closed overlay opacity 0; open -> overlay opacity 1, item0 delay 0ms / item7 delay 420ms (=7*60 stagger), current HOME = rgb(240,71,62) red, ghost items rgba(22,21,15,.26), hover -> rgb(22,21,15) solid, Close pill shown; Escape -> closed (opacity 0). Real Close-pill click verified working AFTER the z-index fix (close-z 200 above the header bar) — before the fix the header 'Menu' button intercepted the click (logged F-10). Screenshot: red HOME, solid INDUSTRIES on hover, ghost rest, right contact column, Close pill (matches gapsy). Probe (4x CPU throttle, 5 open/close cycles): 2/508 long frames (0.4%), 59.9fps -> PASS. Zero console errors.
